name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Scholarship scheme funded by the Department of Higher Education providing financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families pursuing regular degree studies.
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students scoring above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class XII board exams
Students pursuing regular undergraduate and postgraduate courses
Students with family annual income not exceeding Rs. 4.5 lakh
benefits: Scholarship amount of Rs. 12,000 per annum at graduation level for the first 3 years and Rs. 20,000 per annum at postgraduate level, transferred directly via DBT.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India.
Central sector higher education scholarship scheme applicable across all recognized higher education institutions in India.
Meritorious students who have scored above the 80th percentile in the 10+2 pattern with parental income up to Rs. 4.5 lakh.
Rs. 12,000 per annum for undergraduate degree and Rs. 20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies via Direct Benefit Transfer.
Application submission exclusively handled via National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in.
Active annual cycle with biometric authentication on NSP for institutional verification.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Students pursuing courses via correspondence or distance education, or holding any other scholarship are not eligible.

required_documents.title: Class XII Marksheet
required_documents.description: Board certificate verifying student scored in top 20th percentile.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Central / State Board of Secondary Education

required_documents.title: Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Competent authority income certificate proving family income under Rs. 4.5 lakh.

required_documents.title: College Bonafide Student Certificate
required_documents.description: Verification of admission in regular graduate / postgraduate program.

required_documents.title: Bank Account Details
required_documents.description: Aadhaar seeded bank account in applicant's name for DBT.
